community.title: Connect an agent to start screening its actions.
community.description: Guided setup starts in monitor mode. Captured shell actions, MCP tool calls and one-off checks build the local decision record.
community.hostBoundaryTitle: Extend protection from agent intent to the host.
community.hostBoundaryDescription: Community screens supported agent actions before execution. On supported Linux hosts, Active Defence adds independent host telemetry, incident triage and evidence-backed response, including eBPF enforcement and the kernel Execution Gate. macOS and Windows host protection is planned, not implied by this dashboard.

degraded.recovery: Recorded next step: Restore verified runtime convergence before making an enforcement claim
